name: ProFAB-open
description: A protein functional annotation benchmark that provides standardized tasks and data for assessing methods that predict protein functions.
reputation: Designed to standardize protein function prediction tasks; useful to computational biology groups though not as established as large community challenges (e.g., CAFA).
notes: Multi-label, highly imbalanced labels and evolving annotations; risk of sequence-similarity contamination between train/test splits; not an LLM-specific benchmark.
